title: Buying at the Market Stall

readiness.math: counting out coins one by one (younger); making an amount with 1-, 2- and 5-coins and counting change (older)

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Good day! Have you come shopping? Everything on my stall has its price, on a little tag.

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Count your coins onto the dish, then press Pay.

older.prompt: The {item} costs {n}. Make {n} with your coins. If you put more, I'll give you change.

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: The {item} costs {n}. Put that many coins on the dish, then press Pay.

feedback.all_good: Thank you kindly! Enjoy your supper.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Fair coins for good food: that's how a market works. Come again!

journal_line: I bought food at Mr. Tobias's stall and counted out the coins myself.
unavailable_text: You've done your shopping for today.
